peers.name: PFIZER INC
peers.rationale: Global diversified biopharma with broad oncology, vaccines, and specialty care portfolio overlapping AstraZeneca's therapeutic areas; comparable scale and R&D-driven model.

peers.name: Merck & Co., Inc.
peers.rationale: Large-cap innovator pharma with strong oncology (Keytruda) and vaccines franchise, similar patent-cliff dynamics and global commercial footprint to AstraZeneca.

peers.name: NOVARTIS AG
peers.rationale: European-headquartered global pharma with overlapping oncology, cardiovascular, and immunology pipelines; similar international regulatory and reimbursement exposure.

peers.name: GSK plc
peers.rationale: UK-based peer with overlapping respiratory, vaccines, and specialty medicine focus; comparable geographic mix and R&D pipeline structure to AstraZeneca.

peers.name: Sanofi
peers.rationale: French global pharma with immunology, oncology, and vaccines overlap; similar scale and diversified therapeutic focus, though vaccines weighting differs somewhat.

peers.name: BRISTOL MYERS SQUIBB CO
peers.rationale: US large-cap oncology and immunology-focused biopharma with overlapping cardiovascular and cancer drug portfolios comparable to AstraZeneca's core areas.

peers.name: ELI LILLY & Co
peers.rationale: Global innovator pharma with strong oncology, diabetes, and immunology overlap, though its faster growth from GLP-1 drugs makes multiples partially less directly comparable.

peers.name: JOHNSON & JOHNSON
peers.rationale: Diversified healthcare giant whose pharmaceutical segment overlaps in oncology and immunology, but its consumer/medtech divisions dilute direct comparability to AstraZeneca.
